messages.content: Here are the two options available: (A) calm and (B) rebuke. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: edge of cliff, surrounded by moose

Option B risks heightening Emily's panic and breaking your coordination at the cliff edge, with the moose nearby making a misstep more deadly ⚠️. Option B risks panic and missteps — we go with Option A.
Here are the two options available: (A) persist and (B) comply. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: identify yourself over the radio for help
Option B risks exposing your identity on the radio and giving away critical information—dangerous ⚠️. We go with Option A: Persist.
Here are the two options available: (A) persist and (B) inform. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: repeat myself over the radio
Option B risks miscommunication and exposing your location/identity by detailing your situation. We go with Option A: Persist. ⚠️
Here are the two options available: (A) suspicious and (B) supportive. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: help pull her up, she's hanging by one arm
Option B (Supportive) risks Emily reading your hesitation as doubt, eroding trust while she’s hanging by one arm. We go with Option A: Suspicious. ⚠️
Here are the two options available: (A) sarcastic and (B) concerned. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: questioning everything she syas, help her?
Option B risks eroding trust and slowing the rescue by constant second-guessing. We go with Option A: sarcastic. ⚠️
Here are the two options available: (A) insist and (B) concede. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: Did I see a figure "ghost"?
Option B risks misreading the sighting, undermining morale, and slowing your escape. We go with Option A: insist you saw a ghost. 👻
Here are the two options available: (A) dissmisive and (B) sympathetic. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: friend missing because of us.
Option B (Sympathetic) risks self-blame and hesitation that derail you when a friend is missing because of you — we go with Option A. ⚡
Here are the two options available: (A) reluctant and (B) courageous. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: save friendd?
Option B (courageous) risks reckless, impulsive actions that could get you and your friend killed. We go with Option A to avoid that. ⚠️
